title: Spring Data JPA: derived count query for 'select distinct new Dto(coalesce(...))' is malformed ('coalescenickname') and the repository fails to start

sources.license: Facts summarized from a public GitHub issue/PR; short error excerpt quoted.

symptom: Repository creation fails with QueryCreationException: Count query validation failed for 'select count(distinct coalescenickname, name) from Member where active = true', caused by a Hibernate SemanticException 'Could not interpret path expression coalescenickname'. It affects a Page-returning @Query written as 'select distinct new Dto(coalesce(nickname, name)) from Member where ...' with no alias on the entity.
cause: When deriving the count query, QueryTransformers.CountSelectionTokenStream.withoutConstructorExpression() removes every parenthesis instead of only the constructor wrapper and joins the remaining tokens without whitespace, so coalesce(nickname, name) turns into 'coalescenickname, name'.
fixSummary: Give the @Query an explicit count query: countQuery = "select count(distinct coalesce(nickname, name)) from Member where active = true", which counts distinct display values as the page total should. Adding an alias to the entity (from Member m where m.active = true) also avoids the broken derivation. Fixed in Spring Data JPA 4.0.8 (2025.1.8).
